entities.name: Doun
entities.description: A kithkin village or town in Shadowmoor; the Lorwyn counterpart is called a clachan.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane where douns are found.

entities.name: Ballygol
entities.description: A doun whose population was wiped out by the elves of the Dusklight Safehold.

entities.name: Dusklight Safehold
entities.description: An elf stronghold whose elves wiped out the population of Ballygol.

entities.name: Bristlebane
entities.description: A doun home to the Hound of Bristlebane and considered the most violent in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Greymeadow
entities.description: A doun ringed by three layers of walls and gates, home of the Cobbik family and others.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A doun ruled by Cenn Molla Welk; its clachan equivalent is Goldmeadow.

events.summary: The population of Ballygol was wiped out by the elves of the Dusklight Safehold.
events.quote: population wiped out by the elves of the Dusklight Safehold

relations.note: Mistmeadow is ruled by Cenn Molla Welk.
